Solution.S:
Let $f(x) = \tan^{-1}x \Rightarrow f'(x) = \frac{1}{1+x^2}$.

$$u = \frac{f(x)}{f(x)+1}$$

$$\frac{du}{dx} = \frac{(f+1)f' - f \cdot f'}{(f+1)^2} = \frac{f'}{(f+1)^2} = \frac{1}{(1+x^2)(\tan^{-1}x + 1)^2}$$

$$v = \tan^{-1}(f(x))$$

$$\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1}{1 + f^2} \cdot f' = \frac{1}{(1+x^2)(1 + (\tan^{-1}x)^2)}$$

$$\therefore \frac{du}{dv} = \frac{du/dx}{dv/dx} = \frac{1 + (\tan^{-1}x)^2}{(1 + \tan^{-1}x)^2}$$

Thus the correct option is B.
